metadata.title: The sharp Chern--Simons--Sobolev inequality and its variants
metadata.abstract: We introduce and prove a new conformally invariant Chern--Simons--Sobolev inequality, and classify all optimizers, which are the Hopf map $\pi:\mathbb{S}^{2n+1}\to\mathbb{CP}^n$ composed with a symplectic diffeomorphism of $\mathbb{CP}^n$ and an orientation-preserving conformal transformation of $\mathbb{S}^{2n+1}$. The proof uses the sharp curl-Sobolev inequality and a rigidity argument for its equality case. Motivated by the main result, we also introduce the spherical Radu--Tchrakian--Yang functional, and prove the global minimality of the Hopf map for radii in a neighborhood of $((n!)^2/n)^{1/(4n-4)}$, and characterize all minimizers. We also prove local instability for sufficiently small and sufficiently large radii, with explicit lower bounds for the Morse index.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 尖锐不等式与极值分类
analysis.workSummary: 建立共形不变的 Chern–Simons–Sobolev 不等式，分类极值映射并研究相关球面泛函的稳定性。
techniques: Hopf 映射与辛微分同胚
analysis.breakthrough: 所有极值由 Hopf 映射结合底空间辛微分同胚及保定向共形变换得到；在特定半径邻域证明 Hopf 映射全局极小。
analysis.limitations: 泛函极小性只在所给半径邻域成立；充分小与充分大半径反而局部不稳定，不能宣称所有半径均稳定。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 尖锐常数、等号分类与稳定性区间形成完整结果链。
